top.headline: New Etihad Rail Stations Open in Dubai and Sharjah
top.summary: Etihad Rail expands its passenger network by opening new stations in Al Yalayis, Dubai, and Al Dhaid, Sharjah. High public demand prompted this latest accessibility upgrade.

top.title: Etihad Rail announces more trains between Abu Dhabi and Dubai to meet demand

top.headline: Etihad Rail Adds More Dubai-Abu Dhabi Trains

top.headline: Tenant and Landlord Debate EV Charger Installation Costs
